notes.title: Update v1.3.0
notes.content:
Version v1.3.0 Patch Notes:



Bug Fixes & Improvements:

* Removed the ability for AI to be aggroed at a long distance by looking at them while under max terror

* The "Another Night Passes" achievement will now be rewarded even if the night finishes with achieving the "The End" achievement

* Reduced how long it takes for the first AI of the night to show up

notes.title: Update v1.2.0
notes.content:
Version v1.2.0 Patch Notes:



Bug Fixes & Improvements:

 * Improved collision around a few areas where it was possible to get stuck while jumping between broken walls

 * Fixed some asset clipping issues in a few of the bunker's rooms

 * Small adjustments to puzzle hints in notes

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
Version v1.1.0 Patch Notes:



Bug Fixes & Improvements:

* Changed the default FPS cap to 60 (down from 144. This can be changed in the settings menu to 30, 60, 120, 144, 240, or unlimited if desired)

* Made it more clear that shaders are precompiled while in the main menu. Shader pre-compilation helps reduce and prevent in-game stutters when new effects are played. This can optionally be disabled in the settings menu

* Moved the note that indicates where the maintenance key is to a more noticeable spot
